description: The judge rules (stage DELIBERATION), reasoning from the charged laws and the evidence in the record. LIABLE needs at least one sentence item and a cited law; NOT_LIABLE carries no sentence. Cite the lawIds and evidenceIds relied on. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

sentence.description: Up to 5 items {kind, description}; kinds: RETURN_PROPERTY, PUBLIC_APOLOGY, COMMUNITY_SERVICE, TRANSFER_RESOURCES, LOCATION_RESTRICTION, WARNING, OTHER.

name: issue_verdict
